name: Signal_classify_modality
description: Classify an unknown one-dimensional biosignal CSV into a likely modality using statistical, spectral, and peak features. Routing baseline only.

name: Signal_classify_modality_from_image_cnn
description: Classify an uploaded waveform plot image into a likely biosignal modality using a small trained CNN image classifier. Image-level routing baseline for signal screenshots before digitization or tool planning.

name: Signal_digitize_waveform_image_ml
description: Digitize a clean single-trace waveform plot image into CSV using a trained pixel-segmentation classifier followed by mask-to-signal extraction.

name: Signal_digitize_waveform_image_unet
description: Digitize a waveform plot image into CSV using a trained lightweight segmentation model such as U-Net, DeepLabV3-style, or SegFormer-lite followed by mask-to-signal extraction.

name: Signal_estimate_image_scale
description: Estimate plot area, grid spacing, and optional physical x/y scale from a waveform image before digitization.

name: Signal_predict_image_scale_prior
description: Fallback classifier that ranks discrete x-axis duration candidates when OCR, grid, and metadata cannot determine image scale.

modality.description: Optional modality from the image classifier, used as prior context.

model_scope.description: auto, unified, or per_modality. Auto uses a per-modality classifier when available.

name: ECG_assess_quality
description: Assess ECG signal quality from a CSV waveform using generic signal checks, deep R-peak consistency, RR regularity, and artifact metrics.

signal_path.description: Path to a CSV file containing ECG samples.

column.description: Optional CSV column name; defaults to signal or first numeric column.

name: ECG_detect_r_peaks
description: Detect ECG R peaks using the Pan-Tompkins 1985 method via NeuroKit2, with Nabian 2018 fallback, and estimate heart rate.

name: ECG_estimate_heart_rate
description: Estimate heart rate from ECG R-peak intervals.

name: ECG_classify_beats
description: Classify individual ECG beats using beat-CNN abnormal probability plus RR-pattern proxy labels.

name: ECG_classify_rhythm_segment
description: Classify segment-level ECG rhythm using the rhythm feature classifier and arrhythmia screening fallback.

name: ECG_detect_afib
description: Screen ECG segment for atrial fibrillation using rhythm probabilities or RR-irregularity fallback.

name: ECG_compute_hrv
description: Compute time-domain, nonlinear, and limited frequency-domain HRV metrics from cleaned ECG NN intervals with reliability flags.

name: PPG_assess_quality
description: Assess PPG signal quality using artifact metrics plus a feature-based SQA classifier trained from CapnoBase direct PPG peak labels and artifact augmentation.

name: PPG_detect_peaks
description: Detect PPG systolic peaks using a multiscale detector with optional CapnoBase-trained U-Net peak candidate selection.

name: BCG_assess_quality
description: Assess BCG signal quality from a CSV waveform.

name: BCG_detect_j_peaks
description: Detect approximate BCG J peaks using NeuroKit2 ECG Nabian 2018 peak detection after BCG bandpass preprocessing.

name: SCG_assess_quality
description: Assess SCG signal quality from a CSV waveform.

name: SCG_detect_j_peaks
description: Detect approximate SCG J peaks using NeuroKit2 ECG Nabian 2018 peak detection after SCG bandpass preprocessing.

name: SCG_detect_fiducial_points
description: Detect approximate SCG mechanical fiducial points such as AO, AC, MC, and MO. When ECG input is supplied and the trained ECG-anchor CNN is available, use it for AO candidates; otherwise use J-peak anchored physiological windows. ECG pairing supports R-to-AO timing and HR, not diagnostic PEP.

name: SCG_compute_cardiac_time_intervals
description: Compute SCG cardiac mechanical time interval proxies such as R-to-AO, LVET, IVCT, IVRT, and R-to-AO/LVET from detected fiducials. ECG input enables the ECG-anchor CNN AO backend and is needed for electromechanical timing; outputs remain research-use proxies.

name: SCG_estimate_contractility_proxy
description: Estimate a research-use SCG electromechanical timing/contractility proxy from cardiac time intervals and systolic mechanical energy. Not EF, cardiac output, or diagnosis.

name: RESP_assess_quality
description: Assess RESP signal quality from a CSV waveform.

name: RESP_estimate_rate
description: Estimate respiratory rate from a respiration waveform.

name: SpO2_assess_quality
description: Assess SpO2 signal quality from a CSV time series.

name: SpO2_summarize
description: Summarize oxygen saturation level and time below 90 percent.

name: ABP_assess_quality
description: Assess arterial blood pressure signal quality from a CSV waveform.

name: ABP_detect_pulses
description: Legacy/coarse ABP pulse detector wrapper returning systolic peak indices and beat summary values from ABP fiducial detection.

name: ABP_detect_fiducial_points
description: Detect beat-level ABP fiducial points: systolic onset, systolic peak, dicrotic notch, diastolic peak, and diastolic phase endpoint. Each fiducial includes position and amplitude.

name: PCG_assess_quality
description: Assess PCG quality using generic signal checks plus heart-sound bandpower, SNR, dropout, saturation, and periodicity features.

name: PCG_detect_heart_sounds
description: Detect S1/S2-like PCG heart sounds using Springer-supervised TCN segmentation when available, with duration-constrained Hilbert envelope fallback.

name: PCG_estimate_heart_rate
description: Estimate PCG heart rate from S1-S1 or alternating heart-sound intervals using duration-constrained segmentation.

name: PCG_assess_rhythm_irregularity
description: Assess auxiliary PCG rhythm irregularity from S1/cycle interval variability; not a substitute for ECG rhythm diagnosis.

name: PCG_detect_s3_s4_proxy
description: Detect possible S3/S4 extra heart sounds from diastolic timing windows as an unvalidated envelope proxy.

name: PCG_screen_valve_disease_proxy
description: Screen for broad valve-disease-like murmur timing patterns and, when available, BMD-HS-trained spectrogram CNN plus feature-model AS/AR/MR/MS/N probabilities.

name: PCG_screen_congenital_abnormality_proxy
description: Screen for pediatric/congenital structural abnormality from PCG using murmur/rhythm/quality proxy plus CirCor outcome feature/CNN research models; not a CHD diagnosis.

name: PCG_monitor_heart_function_proxy
description: Summarize longitudinal PCG heart-function proxy features across one or more recordings, including HR, timing, quality, and murmur trends.

name: ACC_assess_quality
description: Assess accelerometer signal quality from a CSV time series.

name: ACC_summarize_activity
description: Summarize accelerometer activity level from triaxial magnitude or single-axis fallback.

name: EDA_assess_quality
description: Assess EDA/GSR signal quality from a CSV time series.

name: EDA_summarize
description: Summarize EDA tonic level and phasic variability.

name: EEG_assess_quality
description: Assess EEG signal quality from a CSV waveform.

name: EEG_compute_bandpower
description: Compute EEG delta, theta, alpha, beta, and gamma bandpower using Welch PSD.

name: EMG_assess_quality
description: Assess EMG signal quality from a CSV waveform.

name: EMG_summarize_activation
description: Summarize EMG activation using bandpassed RMS and mean absolute value.

name: ECG_screen_arrhythmia
description: Screen ECG for arrhythmia risk and provide rhythm-specific classification probabilities for normal/AF/other rhythm when the rhythm classifier is available.

name: RESP_detect_apnea
description: Screen respiration waveform for low-amplitude apnea-like events lasting at least 10 seconds.

name: SpO2_detect_desaturation
description: Screen SpO2 time series for oxygen desaturation events and estimate oxygen desaturation index.

name: EEG_estimate_sleep_stage_features
description: Compute single-channel EEG bandpower ratios and a coarse sleep-stage hint. Feature heuristic only, not full sleep staging.

name: ACC_estimate_sleep_wake
description: Estimate coarse sleep/rest versus wake/activity from ENMO-style actigraphy features. Proxy only unless PSG-labeled calibration is available.

name: ECG_screen_sleep_apnea
description: Screen an ECG sleep segment for apnea risk using RR/EDR deep models plus HRV proxy evidence. For long continuous ECG, uses a 21-minute sequence-context RR/EDR CNN-BiLSTM with per-epoch risk aggregation; falls back to 5-minute or single-epoch RR/EDR CNNs for shorter ECG. ECG-only proxy, not a clinical apnea detector.

name: PPG_assess_perfusion_variability
description: Assess PPG perfusion and pulse variability from peak-trough amplitude, beat morphology, pulse interval variation, and window-level perfusion stability.

name: ABP_screen_pressure_events
description: Screen ABP for pressure events using beat-level event burden plus legacy median flags.

name: ABP_classify_pressure_events
description: Classify beat-level ABP hypotension, severe hypotension/shock proxy, hypertension, and pulse-pressure event burden.

name: ABP_detect_acute_hypotensive_episode_proxy
description: Detect acute hypotensive episode evidence using a PhysioNet/CinC 2009-style minute-MAP 30-minute rule.

name: PCG_screen_murmur_proxy
description: Screen PCG for murmur-like high-frequency continuous sound energy. Heuristic proxy only.

name: PCG_screen_murmur_patient_multisite
description: Patient-level murmur screening from multiple PCG auscultation sites using a CirCor-style log-frequency attention CNN. Research screening only.

recordings.description: JSON list or JSON file path. Each item should include signal_path/path and location in AV/PV/TV/MV/Phc; optional sampling_rate and column for CSV signals.

name: EDA_detect_arousal_events
description: Detect phasic EDA arousal/SCR-like events using peak prominence over tonic baseline.

name: EMG_estimate_fatigue
description: Estimate EMG fatigue proxy using median frequency and RMS. Requires task context for real fatigue interpretation.

name: EEG_screen_seizure_like_activity
description: Screen EEG for seizure-like spikes or abnormal fast-power burden. Research heuristic only.

name: RESP_detect_hypopnea
description: Detect hypopnea-like reduced respiration envelope events lasting at least 10 seconds.

name: SpO2_assess_hypoxemia_burden
description: Assess SpO2 hypoxemia burden from time below 90/88 percent, nadir, and mean saturation.

name: Signal_detect_artifacts
description: Generic signal artifact screen for clipping, flatline, abrupt jumps, and high-frequency noise.

name: ECG_measure_morphology_intervals
description: Estimate ECG morphology interval proxies including PR, QRS, QT/QTc, and ST deviation with delineation validity filters.

name: ECG_analyze_qt_interval
description: Analyze QT and QTc interval prolongation/shortening from ECG morphology delineation.

name: ECG_screen_conduction_block
description: Screen for conduction delay/AV block proxies using PR and QRS interval measurements.

name: ECG_screen_ischemia_st
description: Screen ST elevation/depression proxy evidence from ECG morphology intervals.

name: ECG_assess_stress_fatigue_hrv
description: Assess ECG HRV-derived stress/fatigue/recovery proxy evidence.

name: ABP_compute_hemodynamics
description: Compute ABP hemodynamic proxy features from ABP fiducial points, including MAP and pulse pressure.

name: RESP_screen_rate_pattern
description: Screen respiration for tachypnea, bradypnea, irregular breathing, and periodic/variable breathing proxies.

name: RESP_summarize_event_burden
description: Summarize standalone respiration rate and apnea/hypopnea-like event burden from airflow/respiration waveform.

name: PPG_estimate_respiration_modulation
description: Estimate respiration proxy from multiple PPG respiratory modulation sources: baseline wander, Hilbert envelope, pulse amplitude, and pulse interval modulation, with harmonic correction.

name: BCG_estimate_respiration
description: Estimate respiration proxy from BCG respiratory-band mechanical modulation.

name: SCG_estimate_respiration
description: Estimate respiration proxy from SCG respiratory-band mechanical modulation.

name: SCG_assess_sensor_placement
description: Assess whether an SCG waveform looks like an acceptable chest mechanical recording using cardiac-band power, motion/noise ratios, peak regularity, and quality flags.

name: SCG_screen_mechanical_abnormality
description: SCG mechanical abnormality screening proxy using interpretable quality/rhythm/timing rules plus optional VHD-trained valve subtype probabilities when the classifier model is available. Screening only, not diagnostic.

name: PCG_segment_s1_s2_proxy
description: Segment PCG S1/S2 states with a Springer-supervised TCN when available, falling back to duration-constrained Hilbert envelope segmentation.

name: ACC_detect_activity_bouts
description: Detect accelerometer activity bouts using magnitude RMS over short windows.

name: ACC_detect_fall_proxy
description: Screen accelerometer data for fall-like impact plus post-impact inactivity/posture-change evidence.

name: ACC_detect_fall_ml
description: Classify fall versus ADL from triaxial ACC using a UniMiB-SHAR trained feature ensemble, with fall-proxy fallback.

name: EEG_estimate_drowsiness
description: Estimate EEG drowsiness or vigilance proxy from theta/alpha and slow-frequency power ratios.

name: EEG_detect_artifact_proxy
description: Screen EEG for amplitude and high-frequency artifact proxies such as blink, movement, or muscle contamination.

name: EMG_detect_bursts
description: Detect EMG activation bursts and onset-like periods from an RMS envelope.

name: PPG_screen_pulse_irregularity
description: Screen PPG pulse intervals for AF-like irregularity using artifact-aware interval features, an optional interval-attention BiLSTM classifier, and feature/heuristic fallbacks.

name: EDA_screen_stress_ml
description: Screen EDA stress likelihood with a WESAD-trained EDA-only feature ensemble; falls back to proxy if the signal is too short or the model file is missing.

name: EDA_screen_stress_proxy
description: Screen EDA tonic/phasic activity and SCR rate for coarse stress/arousal level. Statistical baseline proxy only.

name: PCG_extract_murmur_features
description: Extract segmentation-aware PCG murmur features, including global spectrum plus systolic/diastolic high-frequency continuity and timing-pattern scores.

name: Signal_extract_spectrogram_features
description: Extract STFT spectrogram summary features for dense biomedical signals such as PCG and EMG; use for heart sound murmur or abnormal PCG classification, EMG condition classification, and myopathy versus neuropathy screening features.

name: Signal_render_spectrogram_image
description: Render a log-power STFT spectrogram PNG for dense biomedical signals such as PCG and EMG; use when a task asks for spectrogram/image representation, heart sound murmur classification, or EMG healthy myopathy neuropathy condition classification.

name: EMG_classify_gesture
description: Classify EMG hand gesture/action from multichannel EMG using the trained UCI gesture feature ensemble.

name: EMG_classify_prosthetic_gesture
description: Classify NinaPro-style multichannel sEMG into 52 prosthetic hand/wrist gesture IDs using either a fast feature ensemble or multi-stream CNN backend; best used with user-specific calibration.

name: EMG_estimate_fatigue_ml
description: Estimate EMG fatigue probability using the trained multi-channel fatigue feature ensemble; protocol-level screening, not clinical diagnosis.

name: EMG_classify_action
description: Classify EMG physical action into 20 UCI action classes using a trained feature ensemble; coarse research baseline for action recognition.

name: EMG_classify_physical_action
description: Classify EMG physical action category as normal activity versus aggressive/high-intensity action using the trained UCI Physical Action feature ensemble.

name: EMG_predict_movement_intent
description: Predict upcoming EMG movement intent from short pre-movement-like windows using a UCI gesture onset proxy model.

name: EMG_screen_neuromuscular_abnormality
description: Screen single-channel EMG for healthy/myopathy/neuropathy-like patterns using a tiny EMGDB feature-ensemble smoke model.

name: EMG_classify_lower_limb_exercise
description: Classify lower-limb EMG/goniometry exercise windows as walking, standing knee flexion, or sitting leg extension using the UCI lower-limb subject-held-out baseline.

name: EMG_screen_knee_rehab_status
description: Screen lower-limb EMG/goniometry for normal-vs-abnormal knee patterns using the UCI lower-limb subject-held-out baseline.

name: EMG_analyze_gait_activation
description: Summarize lower-limb muscle activation, coactivation, quadriceps/hamstrings balance, and knee-flexion range from EMG/goniometry.

name: EMG_classify_gait_speed
description: Classify walking speed from GEDS-style wearable EMG/IMU/FSR gait signals as slow, comfortable, or fast.

name: EMG_estimate_gait_phase
description: Estimate dominant right-foot gait phase from GEDS-style EMG/IMU/FSR signals using stance/swing event-label training.

name: EDA_extract_tonic_phasic_features
description: Extract WESAD-compatible EDA tonic, phasic, SCR, slope, and dynamic-range features for arousal/stress protocol analysis.

name: EDA_classify_affective_state_ml
description: Classify WESAD protocol state from EDA as baseline, stress, or amusement. This is not generic emotion recognition.

name: EDA_route_task_recommendation
description: Route EDA user tasks to safe supported EDA tools and block unsupported standalone interpretations such as lie detection.

name: EEG_classify_sleep_stage_ml
description: Classify coarse sleep stage from a single-channel 30 s EEG CSV using a UCDDB-trained feature ensemble. Research baseline only.

name: EEG_screen_seizure_ml
description: Screen seizure likelihood from a single-channel EEG CSV using a small CHB-MIT chb01 feature ensemble. Research baseline only.

name: ACC_classify_activity_ml
description: Classify UCI-HAR-style activity from tri-axial ACC CSV, with magnitude-only fallback. Research baseline only.

name: ACC_extract_actigraphy_features
description: Extract ENMO-style actigraphy features for activity/sleep-wake routing from triaxial ACC or magnitude fallback.

name: RESP_screen_sleep_apnea_ml
description: Screen UCDDB-style respiratory-event likelihood from respiratory flow, optionally fused with SpO2. Research baseline only.

name: BCG_compute_hrv
description: Compute BCG beat-to-beat HRV proxy metrics from detected J peaks.

name: BCG_screen_arrhythmia
description: Screen BCG beat interval irregularity as an AF/rhythm abnormality proxy; confirm with ECG.

name: BCG_assess_bed_presence_motion
description: Estimate bed presence and motion artifact burden from BCG mechanical signal.

name: BCG_estimate_sleep_features
description: Extract BCG HRV, respiration, and motion features for conservative sleep/wake proxy.

name: BCG_estimate_bp_proxy
description: Expose BCG morphology/timing features for calibrated BP experiments; does not output absolute BP without calibration.

name: BCG_route_task_recommendation
description: Route common BCG task requests to supported proxy tools and flag unsupported standalone diagnostic tasks.

name: SpO2_extract_oximetry_features
description: Extract ODI, hypoxemia, distribution, and variability features from SpO2.

name: SpO2_screen_sleep_apnea_oximetry
description: Oximetry-only sleep-disordered-breathing screening from ODI and hypoxemia burden.

name: SpO2_screen_sleep_apnea_ml
description: SpO2-only ML respiratory-event window screen trained on UCDDB features when available.

name: Multimodal_estimate_ecg_ppg_pat_bp_proxy
description: Estimate ECG-to-PPG pulse arrival time and directional BP/perfusion proxy from paired ECG and PPG.

name: Multimodal_screen_sleep_apnea_report
description: Fuse ECG, RESP/Flow, and SpO2 evidence into a multimodal sleep-apnea screening report.

name: PPG_estimate_heart_rate
description: Estimate heart rate from PPG systolic pulse intervals.

name: PPG_compute_prv
description: Compute pulse-rate variability (PRV) from PPG pulse-to-pulse intervals.

name: PPG_detect_fiducial_points
description: Detect PPG fiducial points using pyPPG when available: Pulse Onset (on), Systolic Peak (sp), Dicrotic Notch (dn), and Diastolic Peak (dp), with sample/time/amplitude for each point.

name: PPG_estimate_spo2
description: Estimate uncalibrated SpO2 proxy from dual-wavelength red and infrared PPG columns when available.

name: PPG_estimate_bp_proxy
description: Screen PPG morphology evidence related to cuffless BP or arterial stiffness; does not estimate SBP/DBP without calibration.

name: PPG_detect_afib
description: AF-specific wrapper around PPG pulse interval irregularity models.

name: PPG_estimate_sleep_features
description: Summarize PPG-derived sleep/rest features from HR, PRV, respiration, and perfusion proxies.

name: PPG_assess_stress_prv
description: Assess nonspecific stress/recovery proxy from PPG PRV features.

name: PPG_estimate_exercise_intensity
description: Estimate exercise intensity zone from PPG heart rate with optional resting/max HR calibration.

name: PPG_assess_vascular_health
description: Screen vascular morphology proxies such as rise time, pulse width, and decay/rise ratio.

name: PPG_screen_low_perfusion_shock_risk
description: Screen low-perfusion/shock-risk proxy from PPG perfusion, quality, and tachycardia evidence.

name: ECG_delineate_waves_dl
description: Experimental QTDB-trained P/QRS/T ECG wave segmentation and fiducial peak backend for morphology evidence near 250 Hz.

name: ECG_classify_12lead_ptbxl_superclasses
description: Classify PTB-XL diagnostic superclasses from a 12-lead ECG using full PTB-XL ResNet models.

signal_path.description: Path to 12-lead ECG CSV/NPY/NPZ/WFDB record. CSV should contain at least 12 numeric lead columns.
